runtime.arguments: Invalid core command-line arguments. Use --help to list the options.
runtime.help:
Sidevoice core: this node's conversations.
Usage: sidevoice-core [OPTIONS]
  --host HOST              Address to listen on (default 127.0.0.1)
  --port PORT              Port to listen on (default 8768; 0 chooses a free port)
  --data-dir PATH          Private core data directory
  --socket PATH            Local socket path
  --ready-file PATH        Readiness file path
  --launch-id ID           Identifier for this launch
  --log-file PATH          Log path (default core.log beside the data directory)
  --room-credential PATH   Connector-owned room credential file
  --idle-exit SECONDS      Exit after idle seconds (0 disables)
  -h, --help               Show this help
